sloka: को नु दार प्रणाशम् ते साधु मन्येत राघव ।सरितः सागराः शैला देव गन्धर्व दानवाः ॥३-६५-११॥
transliteration: ko nu dāra praṇāśam te sādhu manyeta rāghava ।saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailā deva gandharva dānavāḥ ॥3-65-11॥

translations.english: Just as pious men do not do anything disagreeable towards persons who observe religious vows, so also rivers, seas and mountains, gods, gandharvas and demons are not capable of causing unhappiness to you.
translations.hindi: हे पुरुषश्रेछ ! राजा मान्धाता, नल आदि जैसे बड़े वड़े लोग ओर देवता भी ते सर्वान्तर्यामो दैव से छुटकारा नहों पा सकते
